map-title.description: The display name of the level.

starting-coins.description: The amount of gold the player starts with.

starting-lifes.description: The amount of lives the player starts with.

extra-lifes.description: A toggle to enable or disable the 'Extra Life' purchase button.

extra-lifes-prices.description: The price progression for extra lives. Leave blank for default settings.

description-text.description: A brief overview or lore of the map shown before the game starts.

tile-size.description: The fixed pixel dimensions of each map tile. This value is read-only.

difficulty.description: The challenge level of the map, usually represented by stars.
